pages.title: Access and sign-in
steps: Use your own account
Enter the email and password for your dancer or club team account, then press Sign in. Complete any email-confirmation prompt.
Check your destination
Confirm the stage name or club before working. VIP guests must use VIP sign in or www.mydancr.com/vip.
Recover the original account
Use Forgot password? or Forgot email? if needed. An original-account warning on a shared test phone is an account-recovery issue; do not create another dancer account.
pages.done: The correct identity, club and permitted controls are displayed.
pages.issue: Club access missing? Ask the owner to check your membership. See the troubleshooting table on p. 26.

pages.title: Alerts and the notification inbox
pages.path: Club: Manage venue | Dancer: Account / Overview
steps: Open Notification preferences
Check the optional categories available to your account. Club owners and managers should confirm venue, VIP and support alerts needed for their shift.
Check Email
Email starts on by default. Leave it enabled for the alerts you need; an earlier choice to mute optional alerts still applies.
Enable phone push
Use Enable notifications and accept the device prompt. On iPhone, follow the displayed Add to Home Screen instructions and open the installed app when required.
Check your mail app
Email banners depend on the phone's mail-app settings for your account address. These are separate from website push permission.
Act in the operational queue
Mark all read and Clear all affect the inbox only. Return to the table, VIP or ride request to record the real outcome.
pages.done: Your mailbox is accessible, preferences match your duties and the device permission is set.
pages.issue: No alert? Check email address, spam and device permission; keep watching the dashboard queue meanwhile.
extras: Notification read does not mean request completed. Essential account/security messages and operational alerts may be handled separately from optional updates.

pages.title: Publish and maintain the venue
pages.path: Manage venue > Review your prepared venue page
steps: Check the prepared package
Verify the location, name, address, phone, website, hours and official logo. Compare the Club Deal, guest terms and subscription with the agreement.
Preview customer experience
Open the preview and check the location, offer, links and customer presentation.
Correct or publish
For corrections, enter at least 10 characters under Need changes? and press Request changes. When everything is correct, select Approve & make live.
Verify the result
Wait for confirmation, then Open live venue page. The correct venue and approved offer should appear.
Maintain the commercial status
Request deal corrections through the club controls or Support. Owners/managers can view finance; contact MyDancr Support for subscription changes.
pages.done: The page shows LIVE and the public information matches the agreed package.
pages.issue: An approved venue can be hidden without an active Club Deal. Its approval and affiliations remain saved; resolve the deal rather than recreating the club.
extras: An authorized representative submits the venue request. MyDancr reviews it, completes the agreement and issues a private signup code. Use that code to create the club account. The prepared workspace is private until the venue package is approved.

Manage venue > Club participation > Remove club from MyDancr. Read the confirmation: this removes club participation, affiliations and check-in access, not dancers' personal accounts or media. Returning requires a new agreement and review.
Preview customer experience > Approve & make live. These are source-verified labels; a current screenshot was unavailable.

pages.title: Invite and manage the team
steps: Choose the role
Manager handles venue, roster, media reviews, VIP, rides and contacts. Staff has limited operational access. Only the owner manages team membership.
Invite team member
Enter Team member email, select Manager or Staff under Access level, then press Invite team member. An existing guest or dancer account can conflict.
Finish invitation setup
The recipient follows the private invitation and account-setup steps. If email fails and a secure link is supplied, share it only with that person.
Confirm access
Have the recipient verify the club and visible tabs. Check that their membership is active.
Remove stale access
Use the role control or Remove when duties change. Use Revoke for an unused invitation that should no longer be accepted.
pages.done: Each team member has their own account and only the access their work needs.
pages.issue: There is no reviewer-only club role. Assigning a content reviewer as Manager also gives them broader manager permissions.
extras: Owner: team + club operations. Manager: club operations + media approval. Staff: limited operations; no media approval, VIP, rides or contacts.
Never place invitation links in public signs, screenshots or shared training handouts.

pages.title: Receive and verify table QR signs
steps: Prepare the table map
List the club location and table numbers. Specify a first and last number for each range, plus any exceptions or separately numbered areas.
Check the requested count
Both endpoints count: 201-210 makes 10 tables; 201-211 makes 11. Match the requested signs to the physical tables.
Request signs from MyDancr admin
Send the club and numbering plan through MyDancr Support. MyDancr admin creates the QR codes and supplies the signs. Tell the team about existing signs before requesting replacements.
Check the supplied signs
Check the signs supplied by MyDancr admin for the table number, Powered by MyDancr, www.mydancr.com and a complete, readable QR image before placement.
Match each sign to its table
Open each QR destination and confirm the club and table. Install the matching sign. Report wrong or obsolete codes to Support and remove old physical signs.
pages.done: Every installed code opens its intended club/table and matches the printed number.
pages.issue: Stop using a sign with the wrong destination. Send Support the club, printed table number and exact issue. Dancers use a separate dressing-room NFC sticker.
extras: MyDancr admin creates and manages the QR codes. The venue supplies table numbers, receives the signs, verifies destinations and places them. Venue staff do not generate QR codes.

pages.title: Check stickers and customer views
pages.path: Dancers & tables > sticker controls | Club dashboard > View internal
steps: Confirm the supplied sticker
Check the club, intended dressing-room placement and sticker label with MyDancr Support. Keep the label in the club setup record.
Check the installation
Install the assigned sticker in the agreed dressing-room area. Follow the supplied test instructions and verify the intended club before dancers use it.
Report sticker faults
Use Dancers & tables > sticker controls > Test or Support. Include Issue, Details and the sticker label. Stop using a wrong or damaged tag; Support coordinates replacement and deactivation.
Check the internal view
Open View internal or a table QR link. Verify club, table, roster, Request buttons and Powered by MyDancr attribution.
Check external and embedded views
Open the live venue page and the actual club website embed. Check location, offer, roster and a dancer profile. Have the website maintainer use the approved embed.
pages.done: The sticker and customer links stay in the intended club context.
pages.issue: Wrong location or person? Stop using that tag/sign/link and contact Support with its label and destination. Keep private setup and invitation links out of public signs.
extras: Internal is the club/table roster; external is public discovery; embedded is a club-branded view. Embedded profiles omit follow, share and follower counts. Staff full profiles can retain MyDancr styling.

pages.title: Open and close the shift
steps: Confirm the club and freshness
Check venue identity and last update; press Refresh after returning to an old tab.
Review the live queues
Check Working now, Table requests, Guest list, VIP requests and Ride requests. Assign a named owner and break cover for each.
Check the roster and review coverage
Compare Working now with the floor. Make sure an owner or manager is handling Media approvals for new or changed uploads.
Reconcile before handover
End check-ins for dancers who left. Resolve table outcomes, pending VIP decisions and unconfirmed rides using facts, not assumptions.
Hand over unresolved work
Record request/upload references, current status, next action and owner. Leave uncertain media private. Lock or sign out of shared devices.
pages.done: The roster is accurate and every open item has a named owner.
pages.issue: Sample cards are training data. Clearing notifications or marking unfinished work complete does not constitute a handover.
extras: Club / shift time / duty manager; then one line per open record: reference - actual state - next action - owner.

pages.title: Manage the roster
steps: Find the dancer
Use Search dancers, Sort dancers, All affiliated / Working now and the available channel filters.
Open the profile
Select the portrait or View profile to confirm the person and approved media.
End an incorrect check-in
Use the card menu (...) > End check-in when the dancer has left or the active session is wrong.
Remove access only when intended
Owners/managers use Remove access for a club-access change, not to end an ordinary shift. Confirm the correct dancer.
Permit a future return
Removed dancers > Allow new tap lets the dancer tap again. It does not restore a shift or automatically start one.
pages.done: The right person is affiliated and their active state matches the floor.
pages.issue: Ending early does not bypass the cooldown. Do not remove/re-add access to force a new shift.
extras: Affiliated = connected to this club. Working now = an active check-in. A dancer can be affiliated without currently working.

pages.title: Handle table requests
steps: Open the right record
Check table and dancer. Portrait opens the full profile; (...) > Request details opens the operational record.
Acknowledge
Use Mark seen once the team has received the request. Coordinate with the dancer; operational dancer alerts can also be sent.
Record arrival or non-arrival
Select Mark arrived only when the dancer reaches the table. Otherwise use Didn't arrive at table when that is the actual outcome.
Finish or cancel
After arrival and completion, select Complete. Use Dismiss for cancellation under the club's procedure.
Verify the state
Wait for the saved update. If the outcome is uncertain, refresh and inspect the same request before repeating an action.
pages.done: The status reflects what happened, not what the team hopes will happen.
pages.issue: Seen is not arrival; a notification marked read is not a completed request.
extras: Pending > Mark seen > Mark arrived > Complete
Seen > Didn't arrive at table. Dismiss cancels the request.

pages.title: Review the guest list
steps: Open the guest list
Open Tonight > Guest list and select Refresh. Confirm the club, visit date and displayed club time before reviewing entries.
Find the expected visit
Choose Tonight, Choose a date or All active passes. Search by name, phone or email. Use Clear to remove a search.
Read the recorded status
Filter Awaiting admission, Admitted or All. These filters show recorded statuses; they do not admit anyone. All can also include expired passes.
Expand the guest details
Open the guest row to see contact details, Joined guest list and Pass valid until. If an admission has been recorded, the row also shows its recorded time.
Check missing or stale entries
Clear filters, confirm the date and use Load more guests if available. Refresh before reporting a discrepancy to the duty manager with the guest reference and time.
pages.done: The correct guest, visit period and latest recorded status are identified; any discrepancy has a named follow-up owner.
pages.issue: A guest-list entry is not proof of attendance. If an update fails, the last loaded list may remain visible; check the error and update time.
extras: The club dashboard is for viewing the guest list. Pass scanning and admitting guests are not performed in this dashboard. Follow the club's separate entry procedure.
Refresh / Visit date / Find a guest / Search / Clear / Awaiting admission / Admitted / All / Load more guests. A current screenshot of this list is unavailable.
Use contact details only for the relevant visit and permitted purpose. Being on the guest list does not itself establish a marketing subscription.

pages.title: Manage VIP access and visits
steps: Invite the guest
Invite guest > email + optional private nickname > Send invitation. Only the invited email can use the link. Direct the guest to /vip.
Maintain VIP access
Invitations: Resend email / New share link replaces the old unused link; Revoke invitation cancels it. VIP guests: search > (...) > nickname or Remove VIP access.
Read the request
Requests > Pending requests / All statuses; use Newer / Older requests as needed. Check visit date, time, venue timezone, party and selected dancers.
Confirm availability, then respond
Open the dancer profile if needed. Coordinate availability, expand Add message for a guest-facing note, then Confirm request or Decline.
Handle a later cancellation
On the confirmed record, use Cancel confirmed request and verify the saved state. Existing requests remain available if VIP access is removed.
pages.done: The correct guest has access and each visit has the intended decision.
pages.issue: Current VIP dancer selection is limited to Working now at that venue. Selection is interest, not guaranteed availability.
extras: Links last seven days. Do not publish them. Nicknames are private to club owners/managers.
A public I'm Going signal, an admission pass and a VIP request do not confirm one another.

pages.title: Ride requests and shared contacts
steps: Find the ride
Show rides filters Open (last 48 hours), All requests, Completed or Cancelled. Use Load older requests or Open pickup inbox if needed.
Contact the guest
Check venue, name, pickup point, party size and contact details. Select Call guest or use the supplied email to agree availability and timing.
Update Ride status
Record Received, Contacted, Arranged, Completed or Cancelled as events occur. Wait for the saved result; coordinate transport with the team.
Check contact permission

Contacts > choose Shared contacts, Guest list, Email updates or Text updates > search. Read Contact & sharing details. Visit details only is not an update subscription; email and text permissions are separate.
Hand over unresolved rides
Give the next manager the request reference, actual arrangement and next action. Follow the current club offer and transport terms.
pages.done: The guest knows whether a ride is arranged and the status matches the agreement.
pages.issue: The public pickup form is not a confirmed ride. Ride status does not verify club admission. The old pickup chat is retired.
extras: Follow up only for the recorded purpose. Guest Account > Email communications lets the guest subscribe or unsubscribe from optional MyDancr emails; this is separate from club update permissions. Essential account emails continue.
Owners/managers handle VIP, rides and shared contacts. Keep guest details with the people responsible for the visit.

pages.title: Read club results
steps: Set a fair comparison
Choose Tonight, 7 days, 30 days or All time. Keep the same club and dates when comparing people or periods.
Read recorded activity
Review working time, table outcomes, guest-list admissions, VIP demand, customer interest and other available sections.
Find a dancer
Use search and the Dancer performance sort controls. Open Score details for the manager view.
Interpret rank in context
Rank is relative to eligible dancers in that club/period. Ties can share rank. Early data or Not enough data is not a zero-performance judgment.
Coach from observable activity
Discuss attendance, responses and actual demand. Dancers retain their own activity analytics; scoring details stay with club management.
pages.done: The conclusion uses the right period and is supported by recorded activity.
pages.issue: Views, requests and intentions are not earnings or verified attendance. Weighted ordering continues on discovery grids and video feeds.
extras: This page is for club management. Do not include it in dancer onboarding handouts. No weighting formulas are supplied in this guide.

pages.title: Dancer onboarding
steps: Save your details
Enter a stage name (2-40 characters), select your city and wait for Saved or Details saved.
Add your photos
Submit at least three profile photos in total, including a main photo. The avatar is generated from the main photo; pending uploads count toward the setup form.
Read and accept the agreement
Open the terms, accept the checkbox if you agree and press Continue.
Complete Verify 18+ if required
Follow the secure Ondato document/selfie flow using your own identity. Return to MyDancr and check the result. Not required means the step is not required; it does not mean verified.
Connect to your club
Tap the physical dressing-room sticker and finish the displayed steps. This connection lets the club review pending media; see p. 19.
pages.done: Details are saved and each onboarding requirement shows a clear status.
pages.issue: Setup completion does not publish pending content. Identity verification and media approval are separate. Use account support for a stalled or wrong-account state.
extras: Overview: working status. Profile: details/media. Results: your activity. Account: preferences/help.
Keep ID documents inside the secure verification flow; do not send copies to ordinary club email or chat.

pages.title: Main photo and photo uploads
pages.path: Profile > Main photo / Add photos/videos > Photos
steps: Choose your main photo
Use the Main photo controls to upload or Choose uploaded photo. Crop photo adjusts the card; check that your face stays visible.
Check the automatic avatar
It comes from the main image. Adjust the avatar crop if needed; there is no separate club roster photo to maintain.
Add gallery photos
Select Gallery for one or more files or Camera to take a photo. JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC and HEIF are accepted, up to 25 MB each.
Wait for transfer and review
A failed transfer can be retried. Processing and pending approval are different states. The club queue receives new-dancer media after the first NFC connection.
Organize approved photos
Use (...) for available crop, main-photo, pin or remove actions. Pinning changes your profile gallery order, not shared feed placement. Read rejection notes and replace corrected files.
pages.done: The main image and avatar match, and each upload has a known review status.
pages.issue: The main photo is used for public cards and internal rosters where you are eligible. A saved change is not necessarily approved; the previous approved image may remain during review.
extras: Only you (18+) may appear, including reflections/backgrounds. Follow the coverage and rights rules; no logos, watermarks or contact details. See the full review checklist on p. 23.

pages.title: Upload videos
steps: Check Video rules
Use vertical or square MP4, WebM or MOV, 1-30 seconds long and up to 25 MB.
Confirm both permissions
Only you are shown and the video is of you; and you own or may publish all visuals and audio, including music.
Choose or record
Select Choose video or Record video. Use the offered crop/trim controls to meet the format and duration rules.
Wait for processing and human review
Keep track of transfer, processing and approval separately. AI checks assist the reviewer; passing them does not publish the file.
Verify approved playback
Open your profile Videos tab and play the complete video. Eligible approved videos can also enter MyDancrTV.
pages.done: The approved file plays correctly and contains permitted visuals and audio.
pages.issue: Music on your phone is not proof of publishing rights. For rejected files, read the correction and submit a compliant replacement.
extras: Failed transfer: retry. Processing: wait. Pending approval: club review. Rejected: read reason and correct the file.

pages.title: Check in and end your shift
pages.path: Dressing-room NFC sticker > Overview > Working Now
steps: Tap the physical sticker
Unlock your phone, tap, open the link if prompted and sign in to your dancer account. No particular dashboard page must be open first. Confirm the club.
Choose where you appear
Internal only: club roster, with a full-profile link. External only: public discovery. Both: both surfaces, subject to your eligibility and visibility.
Finish the displayed requirements
On the first tap, your club can review pending media. If review is pending, wait, then refresh your onboarding/dashboard status.
Check Working Now
Confirm the active club and end time. A check-in lasts up to six hours, followed by a six-hour cooldown across clubs. Retapping does not extend it.
End when you leave
Overview > End Working Now > Yes, end now. Choose Keep working if opened by mistake. Ending early does not bypass the cooldown.
pages.done: Working now reflects the correct club and your actual presence.
pages.issue: Public profile visibility is separate from check-in. An original-account warning needs account recovery/support, not another account.

pages.title: Visibility and profile sharing
steps: Check Profile visibility
Read Public or Incognito before changing anything.
Hide temporarily
Go incognito hides your profile and content without deleting the uploads. Wait for the saved status.
Show it again
Make profile public restores visibility subject to approval and account eligibility.
Share your profile
Expand Share profile > Copy link, or Open profile to inspect the destination.
Check the destination
Confirm your stage name, main photo and approved media before sharing. A copied link does not bypass incognito or approval restrictions.
pages.done: The saved visibility matches your intention and the copied URL is yours.
pages.issue: Internal only is a check-in channel. Incognito is a profile-visibility control. They are not interchangeable.

pages.title: Your results and account help
steps: Choose the period and club
Use This shift, 7 days, 30 days or All time and the club selector. Confirm the filters before comparing.
Read demand and outcomes
Review table requests, VIP requests, returning VIP requesters and verified entries. Request details separates available sources/outcomes.
Read your activity
Review shifts/hours, followers, profile views, likes, video views, trends and top content. Active sessions may not yet appear in completed-session totals.
Keep your account reachable
Use Account for preferences and help; see p. 4 for email/push. Use Forgot password? or Forgot email? to recover access.
Report a discrepancy
Include club, selected dates, expected activity and exact message. Use the support format on p. 26; never include passwords or ID files.
pages.done: You know the period, source and meaning of the figures you are reading.
pages.issue: Requests and I'm Going are interest signals. They do not establish attendance, a booking or earnings.
extras: Get help from the right person
Transfer/file problem: retry or correct. Pending media: club reviewer. Account/identity issue: account support. Missing recorded club activity: duty manager, then support.

pages.title: Open the approval queue
steps: Confirm your access
Use an owner or manager account for the right club. Staff cannot approve media; reviewer responsibility does not create a separate restricted role.
Refresh the queue
Select Refresh. New dancers join the club queue after their NFC tap. Check the count and use Previous / Next to work all pages (12 items per page).
Identify the exact item
Read stage name and the Photo, Main photo, Avatar or Video label. Check the actual preview/version, not a previous upload.
Read AI findings
Check running, passed, flagged or manual-review status. Expand AI findings when present. Passing AI is not human approval or proof of identity/rights.
Review, then decide
Apply p. 23 to the full image/video. Use the decision guide on p. 24. Never approve missing previews or unfinished processing.
pages.done: You can inspect the correct item and understand any automated findings.
pages.issue: Disabled approval is not a control to work around. If a preview cannot be inspected, leave it private and follow p. 26.
extras: This capture shows an empty queue. Pending items add the asset preview, AI findings, Review note, Approve and Reject; Previous / Next appear for multiple pages. Those controls are described here, not shown in this capture.
Wait for the success message and removal from the pending queue. Returning to the first page is normal. An uncertain save requires Refresh before another action.

pages.title: Photo and video review checklist
pages.path: Use on every photo, main image, avatar and video
steps: Inspect the complete asset
Photo: whole frame plus final crop. Avatar: face visible. Video: play every scene with audio from beginning to end; do not approve from its thumbnail.
Check people and coverage
Only the uploader, age 18+, may appear, including in backgrounds/reflections. Apply the coverage rules below.
Check text, objects and audio
Look for brands, logos, watermarks, contact details, solicitation and other prohibited content. Listen to the complete audio.
Check rights and technical readiness
The uploader must own or have permission for all visuals/audio. Review AI findings. Do not override a technical block or guess about identity or rights.
pages.done: Every checklist category has been inspected before a publishing decision.
pages.issue: Any uncertainty about people, age, consent, ownership or inspectability: keep the file private and escalate. AI findings are evidence to review, not a substitute for the checklist.

pages.title: Approve, reject or escalate
steps: Choose the correct outcome
Use the three-way guide below. Escalate means leave the item private and contact the responsible team; it is not a dedicated queue button.
Save once and verify
After Approve or Reject, wait for confirmation and removal from the pending queue. If the upload changed or the result is uncertain, Refresh and inspect the current version.
Review replacements anew
A corrected file is a new review. Inspect the replacement itself; do not approve solely because the previous note was addressed.
Check the release
After approval, inspect the eligible profile/internal/public surface. If still hidden, check remaining enrollment, verification, visibility and channel requirements.
pages.done: The saved outcome matches the exact file inspected, and unresolved content stays private.
pages.issue: One approval can release an asset across eligible internal, external and TV surfaces. It does not override profile eligibility.

pages.title: Review every publishing surface
pages.path: Release checklist beyond the media queue
steps: Dancer media
New photos/videos require human approval, including main images and avatars. Existing approved assets are not automatically re-queued; audit them when a historical review is required.
Profile text
Obtain the reviewer's approval of the proposed stage name, city and other visible copy before saving it. These edits do not all wait in a human queue; check the saved result afterward.
Social links
Send link-review questions to MyDancr Support. Include the dancer and link reference; club media approval does not approve a social link.
Venue pages and branding

Have the responsible reviewer approve the proposed logo, imagery and wording before the venue team saves or publishes them. Review the package and Club Deal before Approve & make live (p. 5). Branding uses separate processing rules.
Live internal, external and TV views
After a release, check the correct person and approved content. Report unsafe live content to MyDancr Support for the applicable removal/restriction action.
pages.done: Each content type has a review owner, approval of the proposed version and a verified release path.
pages.issue: Not every text or branding change has a technical hold. The team must follow this pre-publication sign-off procedure; the media queue alone cannot enforce it.
extras: Club policy: the assigned reviewer signs off on content first. For edits without a technical hold, agree the exact file/copy before saving. Do not use the live page as the draft.
Record club, dancer/asset reference, decision, reason when needed, reviewer and time under your team procedure. Avoid duplicating sensitive source media in ordinary messages.

pages.title: Troubleshooting and escalation
pages.done: One owner has the record reference, a factual problem description and the next action.
pages.issue: Escalate suspected unauthorized access, unsafe live content or a privacy incident immediately. Do not circulate the sensitive material.

pages.title: Website grids and club branding
steps: Open the location preview
Select Preview website grid. Confirm the club, working roster and profile destination. A company with several locations needs a separate location code for each.
Copy the supplied code
Select Copy embed code and give it to the company website editor. Copy preview link shares the preview. If copying fails, select and copy the fallback text.
Install on the matching page

The website editor inserts the supplied iframe on that location's HTTPS page. The company city selector must load the matching location page/code. Ask Support to confirm any sample or demo configuration before public launch.
Check the live experience

Use the refresh icon, open a dancer card, inspect Photos and Videos, then use Back. Confirm location/directions links and Powered by mydancr.com. Do not treat the screenshot's earlier city or count as a setup value.
Request brand changes

Send the official logo and desired color to MyDancr Support. Platform Admin > Clubs > Guest colors controls Website embed color and Table QR color separately. Club dashboards and public MyDancr pages retain their own theme.
pages.done: Each location page shows its own eligible roster and the approved brand treatment.
pages.issue: Missing Website grid? Check venue publication and access. Empty results do not justify inserting another club's dancers. Escalate the location and copied URL to Support.
extras: Preview website grid / Copy preview link / Copy embed code. These current controls are source-verified; the earlier screenshot shows the guest-facing result.

pages.title: TV and full-profile media
pages.path: Manage venue > MyDancr TV | dancer profile > Photos / Videos
steps: Open the club TV feed
Select MyDancr TV in Manage venue. It opens TV with the club/city scope. Check the club filter before reviewing the feed. The public TV tab is another entry point.
Review playback
Use the speaker icon to mute/unmute and inspect the full video. The ordinary card list scrolls freely. Follow, like and share controls depend on the viewing context.
Expand the media
Use the corner/expand icon for the immersive viewer. Use its exit or back control to return. Browser controls and fullscreen support differ by device; expansion is not a publication action.
Inspect a full profile

Open the dancer from the roster/grid, choose Photos or Videos and tap an item. Review the intended file, then Back when ready. Profile layout and available actions vary between public, internal, embed and VIP views.
Use the right correction route
Dancers replace uploads through Profile; owners/managers review them in Media approvals. Pending uploads must not be published just to check playback. See pp. 22-25 for the release checks.
pages.done: The approved file plays in the intended club and profile context, with usable sound and expand controls.
pages.issue: Missing video? Check approval, processing, profile eligibility and venue filters first. If still wrong, send the media reference and device/browser to Support.
extras: From the VIP dashboard, Request adds the dancer to the existing request queue. Added to request queue confirms selection; Back returns to the dashboard. Complete the visit request there. Selection alone is not venue confirmation.

pages.title: Refresh and keep information current
pages.path: Use the page or panel Refresh control before acting on old information.
steps: Refresh the relevant screen
Check the club, date, filters and update indicator first. Use the panel refresh icon/button when returning to old information or checking an uncertain save.
Wait for the result
Keep the current record reference. Read any error before retrying. Do not mark an item complete, republish a file or recreate a request to force a refresh.
pages.done: The correct scope has finished updating, and your action uses the current record.
pages.issue: These are current implementation intervals, not a delivery guarantee. Hidden tabs, browser suspension and connection errors can delay updates. Manual refresh remains part of shift checks.

cheats.title: Club Admin
cheats.sub: Owner / club administrator - keep the club ready
steps: 1. Check the club
Manage venue: identity, LIVE/hidden status, official information and active Club Deal. A hidden approved venue may need a deal correction.
2. Assign coverage
Tonight: name the duty manager and media reviewer. Check the live queues, working roster and shift handover.
3. Maintain access
Owner: Team & activity > email > Manager/Staff > Invite team member. Revoke unused invitations and remove departing staff.
4. Publish the package
Review facts/terms > Preview customer experience > Approve & make live. Need changes? Write the correction > Request changes.
5. Check guest-facing links

MyDancr admin creates the QR codes. Send table numbers through Support; receive, check and place the supplied signs. Request NFC stickers through Support. Manage venue > Website grid: Preview website grid, then Copy embed code for that location.
cheats.rule: Club Admin means the venue team, not MyDancr admin. Owner manages team access; managers handle operations and media reviews. Staff cannot approve media.
cheats.help: Wrong access or hidden venue? Check membership, account, active deal and publication state; then use Support.

cheats.title: Managers & talent
cheats.sub: Duty manager - accurate roster, prompt responses, clear handover
steps: 1. Open Tonight
Refresh; compare Working now with the floor. Assign Table requests, Guest list, VIP and Ride requests to named people.
2. Maintain the roster
Dancers & tables > search/filter. Portrait opens profile. (...) > End check-in when someone leaves; Remove access is a separate access change.
3. Record table outcomes
(...) > Request details > Mark seen > Mark arrived > Complete. Use Didn't arrive at table or Dismiss for the actual alternative outcome.
4. Review guests and requests

Guest list: search and review visit details/status; scanning and admission happen outside this dashboard. VIP: check availability > Confirm request / Decline. Ride: contact guest, then update Ride status.
5. Close and hand over
Results: compare the same club/period. Keep rank details with management. Check club media via Manage venue > MyDancr TV. Hand over each open reference with status, next action and owner.
cheats.rule: Seen is not arrived. A request is not a booking. Clearing a notification does not finish the task. VIP guests sign in at /vip.
cheats.help: For a queue error, refresh and check the existing record before repeating an action. Report club, time, reference and message.

cheats.title: Dancers
cheats.sub: Your profile, your uploads and your working status
steps: 1. Build your profile
Save stage name and city. Add at least 3 photos total, including a main photo. Your avatar is created from it.
2. Upload compliant files
Photos: Gallery / Camera; JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or HEIF, up to 25 MB. Video: both permissions > Choose video / Record video; vertical/square MP4, WebM or MOV, 1-30 seconds, up to 25 MB.
3. Finish onboarding
Accept the agreement, complete Verify 18+ if required, then tap the club sticker. This connects pending media to your club reviewer.
4. Manage your shift
Choose Internal only, External only or Both. Overview > Working Now. Leaving: End Working Now > Yes, end now. Up to 6 hours, then a 6-hour cooldown; retapping does not extend it.
5. Check activity and visibility
Results shows your activity. Profile > Visibility & sharing: Incognito hides content; Make profile public restores eligible content; Copy link shares your profile.
cheats.rule: Only you in the upload; follow coverage rules; no logos, watermarks or contact details. Pending content is private until human approval.
cheats.help: Rejected? Read the reason and correct it. Wrong-account warning? Recover the original account. Never share passwords or ID files with club staff.

cheats.title: Content approval
cheats.sub: Assigned club owner or manager - review before release
steps: 1. Open the correct queue
Owner/manager account > Dancers & tables > Media approvals > Refresh. Confirm club, dancer and asset. New dancers join after their NFC tap.
2. Inspect the whole file
Photo: full frame and crop. Video: every scene and all audio. Check people, coverage, logos/contacts, prohibited conduct, rights and AI findings.
3. APPROVE
Complete preview reviewed, no unresolved policy or rights issue, technical checks complete. Press Approve when enabled; wait for confirmation.
4. REJECT
Clear correction: specific Review note > Reject. Example: "Another person is visible in the mirror. Replace with a photo showing only you."
5. ESCALATE
Missing preview, processing, changed file, or uncertainty about age, identity, consent or rights: leave private and contact the club lead/platform team. There is no Escalate button.
6. Verify and continue
Uncertain save? Refresh first. Check eligible publication after approval. Previous / Next covers the full queue. Review replacements anew.
cheats.rule: AI passing is not approval. One approval can release eligible media. Text/branding without a queue still needs reviewer sign-off before saving or publishing.
cheats.help: Keep uncertain content private. Send club, dancer, upload reference and exact issue to the platform team; do not circulate sensitive source material.

pages.title: Start here: prepare the club
pages.path: Manage venue > Review your prepared venue page
steps: Sign in and confirm access
Use your own club account at www.mydancr.com > Sign in. Confirm the club. The owner manages team membership; a manager handles operations. Use Forgot password? or ask the owner if access is missing.
Review the venue package
Manage venue > Review your prepared venue page. Check name, location, address, contact details, hours, official logo, Club Deal, guest terms and subscription against the agreement.
Preview customer experience
Open the preview. Check the correct location, offer, links and customer presentation.
Correct or publish
Need changes? Enter a specific correction of at least 10 characters and press Request changes. When the package is correct, press Approve & make live.
Verify publication
Wait for confirmation, then Open live venue page. Check LIVE status and the agreed venue information. An approved venue may be hidden when its active Club Deal is missing.
pages.done: The page shows LIVE and the public information matches the agreed package.
pages.issue: Hidden venue: check the active deal and saved publication state; request a correction through the club controls or Support. Do not recreate the club.
extras: Review your prepared venue page / Preview customer experience / Need changes? / Request changes / Approve & make live / Open live venue page. A current capture of these controls is unavailable.
Confirm the club and publication state, invite the right team, check table signs and the dancer sticker, then assign the shift and media-review coverage.

An authorized representative submits the venue request. MyDancr reviews it, completes the agreement and issues a private signup code. Use that code to create the club account. The prepared workspace is private until the venue package is approved.

pages.title: Give each teammate the right access
steps: Choose the role
Manager handles venue, roster, media reviews, VIP, rides and contacts. Staff has limited operational access. Only the owner manages team membership.
Invite team member
Enter Team member email, select Manager or Staff under Access level, then press Invite team member. An existing guest or dancer account can conflict.
Finish invitation setup
The recipient follows the private invitation and account-setup steps. If email fails and a secure link is supplied, share it only with that person.
Confirm access
Have the recipient verify the club and visible tabs. Check that their membership is active.
Remove stale access
Use the role control or Remove when duties change. Use Revoke for an unused invitation that should no longer be accepted.
pages.done: Each team member has their own account and only the access their work needs.
pages.issue: There is no reviewer-only club role. Assigning a content reviewer as Manager also gives them broader manager permissions.
extras: Manage venue > Team & activity. Team member email / Access level / Invite team member / Revoke / Remove. A current capture of this panel is unavailable.
A Manager can also approve media and use VIP, rides, contacts, finance and results. Staff cannot approve media. There is no separate restricted content-reviewer role.

pages.title: Receive and verify table QR signs
steps: Prepare the table map
List the club location and table numbers. Specify a first and last number for each range, plus any exceptions or separately numbered areas.
Check the requested count
Both endpoints count: 201-210 makes 10 tables; 201-211 makes 11. Match the requested signs to the physical tables.
Request signs from MyDancr admin
Send the club and numbering plan through MyDancr Support. MyDancr admin creates the QR codes and supplies the signs. Tell the team about existing signs before requesting replacements.
Check the supplied signs
Check the signs supplied by MyDancr admin for the table number, Powered by MyDancr, www.mydancr.com and a complete, readable QR image before placement.
Match each sign to its table
Open each QR destination and confirm the club and table. Install the matching sign. Report wrong or obsolete codes to Support and remove old physical signs.
pages.done: Every installed code opens its intended club/table and matches the printed number.
pages.issue: Stop using a sign with the wrong destination. Send Support the club, printed table number and exact issue. Dancers use a separate dressing-room NFC sticker.
extras: MyDancr admin creates and manages the QR codes. The venue supplies table numbers, receives the signs, verifies destinations and places them. Venue staff do not generate QR codes.

pages.title: Check stickers and customer views
pages.path: Dancers & tables > sticker controls | Club dashboard > View internal
steps: Confirm the supplied sticker
Check the club, intended dressing-room placement and sticker label with MyDancr Support. Keep the label in the club setup record.
Check the installation
Install the assigned sticker in the agreed dressing-room area. Follow the supplied test instructions and verify the intended club before dancers use it.
Report sticker faults
Use Dancers & tables > sticker controls > Test or Support. Include Issue, Details and the sticker label. Stop using a wrong or damaged tag; Support coordinates replacement and deactivation.
Check the internal view
Open View internal or a table QR link. Verify club, table, roster, Request buttons and Powered by MyDancr attribution.
Check external and embedded views
Open the live venue page and the actual club website embed. Check location, offer, roster and a dancer profile. Have the website maintainer use the approved embed.
pages.done: The sticker and customer links stay in the intended club context.
pages.issue: Wrong location or person? Stop using that tag/sign/link and contact Support with its label and destination. Keep private setup and invitation links out of public signs.
extras: Internal is the club/table roster; external is public discovery; embedded is a club-branded view. Embedded profiles omit follow, share and follower counts. Staff full profiles can retain MyDancr styling.

pages.title: Daily oversight and handover
pages.path: Tonight | Manage venue > Notification preferences / Support
steps: Open Tonight and refresh
Confirm club identity and freshness. Compare Working now with the floor. Assign Table requests, Guest list, VIP requests and Ride requests to named people.
Assign review coverage
Name an owner or manager for Media approvals and their break cover. New-dancer media reaches the club after the NFC tap. Give the reviewer the separate Content Approval onboarding guide.
Keep alerts reachable

Manage venue > Notification preferences: email starts on by default; prior optional-alert choices still apply. Check categories, mailbox and spam. Enable phone push through the displayed instructions; iPhone may require Add to Home Screen.
Coordinate administration

Owners/managers can view finance. Send subscription or deal corrections to MyDancr Support. Only the owner manages team access and club withdrawal; follow the full reference procedure before a consequential change.
Verify the handover
Require a reference, actual status, next action and named owner for every unresolved request/review. Keep uncertain media private. Lock or sign out of shared devices.
pages.done: The club is ready, each queue has coverage and unresolved work has a named owner.
pages.issue: Missing access: owner. Stale queue: Refresh and inspect the existing record before repeating an action. Unsafe live content, account or privacy incident: platform support immediately.
extras: Club + account/record reference + local time/timezone + exact error + expected result + next owner. Exclude passwords, ID documents and private links.
Have the trainee find the correct club, locate team and review controls, check one sign destination, and describe an unresolved-item handover. Use read-only navigation or approved training records.

pages.title: Start the shift and check the roster
pages.path: Sign in > club dashboard > Tonight / Dancers & tables
steps: Sign in to the correct club
Use your own owner/manager account. Confirm the club; missing access goes to the owner. Staff has limited controls and cannot approve media or handle VIP, rides or shared contacts.
Open Tonight and refresh
Compare Working now with the floor. Assign Table requests, Guest list, VIP requests, Ride requests and Media approvals to named people.
Find the dancer
Dancers & tables > Search dancers / Sort dancers / All affiliated or Working now. Use channel filters as needed. Portrait or View profile opens the full profile.
Correct the working state

Card menu (...) > End check-in when the dancer leaves. Ending early does not bypass cooldown. Remove access changes club access; it is not the ordinary end-of-shift action. Removed dancers > Allow new tap permits a future tap, not an automatic shift.
Check alerts and review coverage

Manage venue > Notification preferences. Email starts on by default; prior optional-alert preferences apply. Confirm mailbox/device settings. Assign an owner/manager to review media using the Content Approval onboarding guide.
pages.done: The roster matches the floor, live queues have owners and review coverage is assigned.
pages.issue: Refresh stale data. Confirm club and filters before repeating an action. Do not remove and re-add a dancer to force a new shift.
extras: Affiliated means connected to this club. Working now means an active check-in. A dancer may be affiliated without currently working.

pages.title: Handle table requests
steps: Open the right record
Check table and dancer. Portrait opens the full profile; (...) > Request details opens the operational record.
Acknowledge
Use Mark seen once the team has received the request. Coordinate with the dancer; operational dancer alerts can also be sent.
Record arrival or non-arrival
Select Mark arrived only when the dancer reaches the table. Otherwise use Didn't arrive at table when that is the actual outcome.
Finish or cancel
After arrival and completion, select Complete. Use Dismiss for cancellation under the club's procedure.
Verify the state
Wait for the saved update. If the outcome is uncertain, refresh and inspect the same request before repeating an action.
pages.done: The status reflects what happened, not what the team hopes will happen.
pages.issue: Seen is not arrival; a notification marked read is not a completed request.
extras: Pending > Mark seen > Mark arrived > Complete
Seen > Didn't arrive at table. Dismiss cancels the request.

pages.title: Review the guest list
steps: Open the guest list
Open Tonight > Guest list and select Refresh. Confirm the club, visit date and displayed club time before reviewing entries.
Find the expected visit
Choose Tonight, Choose a date or All active passes. Search by name, phone or email. Use Clear to remove a search.
Read the recorded status
Filter Awaiting admission, Admitted or All. These filters show recorded statuses; they do not admit anyone. All can also include expired passes.
Expand the guest details
Open the guest row to see contact details, Joined guest list and Pass valid until. If an admission has been recorded, the row also shows its recorded time.
Check missing or stale entries
Clear filters, confirm the date and use Load more guests if available. Refresh before reporting a discrepancy to the duty manager with the guest reference and time.
pages.done: The correct guest, visit period and latest recorded status are identified; any discrepancy has a named follow-up owner.
pages.issue: A guest-list entry is not proof of attendance. If an update fails, the last loaded list may remain visible; check the error and update time.
extras: The club dashboard is for viewing the guest list. Pass scanning and admitting guests are not performed in this dashboard. Follow the club's separate entry procedure.
Refresh / Visit date / Find a guest / Search / Clear / Awaiting admission / Admitted / All / Load more guests. A current screenshot of this list is unavailable.
Use contact details only for the relevant visit and permitted purpose. Being on the guest list does not itself establish a marketing subscription.

pages.title: Manage VIP access and visits
steps: Invite the guest
Invite guest > email + optional private nickname > Send invitation. Only the invited email can use the link. Direct the guest to /vip.
Maintain VIP access
Invitations: Resend email / New share link replaces the old unused link; Revoke invitation cancels it. VIP guests: search > (...) > nickname or Remove VIP access.
Read the request
Requests > Pending requests / All statuses; use Newer / Older requests as needed. Check visit date, time, venue timezone, party and selected dancers.
Confirm availability, then respond
Open the dancer profile if needed. Coordinate availability, expand Add message for a guest-facing note, then Confirm request or Decline.
Handle a later cancellation
On the confirmed record, use Cancel confirmed request and verify the saved state. Existing requests remain available if VIP access is removed.
pages.done: The correct guest has access and each visit has the intended decision.
pages.issue: Current VIP dancer selection is limited to Working now at that venue. Selection is interest, not guaranteed availability.
extras: Links last seven days. Do not publish them. Nicknames are private to club owners/managers.
A public I'm Going signal, an admission pass and a VIP request do not confirm one another.

pages.title: Ride requests and shared contacts
steps: Find the ride
Show rides filters Open (last 48 hours), All requests, Completed or Cancelled. Use Load older requests or Open pickup inbox if needed.
Contact the guest
Check venue, name, pickup point, party size and contact details. Select Call guest or use the supplied email to agree availability and timing.
Update Ride status
Record Received, Contacted, Arranged, Completed or Cancelled as events occur. Wait for the saved result; coordinate transport with the team.
Check contact permission

Contacts > choose Shared contacts, Guest list, Email updates or Text updates > search. Read Contact & sharing details. Visit details only is not an update subscription; email and text permissions are separate.
Hand over unresolved rides
Give the next manager the request reference, actual arrangement and next action. Follow the current club offer and transport terms.
pages.done: The guest knows whether a ride is arranged and the status matches the agreement.
pages.issue: The public pickup form is not a confirmed ride. Ride status does not verify club admission. The old pickup chat is retired.
extras: Follow up only for the recorded purpose. Guest Account > Email communications lets the guest subscribe or unsubscribe from optional MyDancr emails; this is separate from club update permissions. Essential account emails continue.
Owners/managers handle VIP, rides and shared contacts. Keep guest details with the people responsible for the visit.

pages.title: Review results and hand over
steps: Select the club and period
Results > Tonight, 7 days, 30 days or All time. Keep the same club and dates when comparing activity.
Read actual activity
Review working time, table outcomes, admissions, VIP demand and other available activity. Views, requests and intentions do not establish earnings or verified attendance.
Use the manager performance view

Find the dancer using search/sort and open Score details. Rank is relative to eligible dancers in the selected club/period; ties may share rank. Early data or Not enough data needs context. Keep scoring information with management.
Reconcile the shift
End check-ins for dancers who left. Record actual table outcomes, unresolved VIP decisions and ride arrangements. Clearing notifications does not complete these tasks.
Hand over unresolved work

Give each open reference its actual status, next action and owner. Keep uncertain media private. Sign out or lock shared devices. Demonstrate the main queues using read-only navigation or approved training records before independent use.
pages.done: Results use the correct period and every open task has a named owner.
pages.issue: Do not mark unfinished work complete for a tidy queue. Dancers retain their own activity analytics; manager scoring details are not dancer training.
extras: Club + record reference + selected period + time/timezone + expected result + exact result/error. Share a safely cropped screenshot, never credentials or private invitation links.
Refresh and inspect the same record before retrying. Take account access issues to the owner; unresolved technical or privacy issues to platform support.

pages.title: Start here: complete your profile
steps: Use your original dancer account
www.mydancr.com > Sign in. Confirm your stage name/account before editing. Use Forgot password? or Forgot email? to recover access; do not make another account to clear a device warning.
Save your details
Enter a stage name (2-40 characters), select your city and wait for Saved or Details saved.
Add your photos
Submit at least three profile photos in total, including a main photo. The avatar is generated from the main photo; pending uploads count toward the setup form.
Read and accept the agreement
Open the terms, accept the checkbox if you agree and press Continue.
Complete Verify 18+ if required
Follow the secure Ondato document/selfie flow using your own identity. Return to MyDancr and check the result. Not required means the step is not required; it does not mean verified.
Connect to your club
Tap the physical dressing-room sticker and finish the displayed steps. This connection lets the club review pending media; follow guide p. 4.
pages.done: Details are saved and each onboarding requirement shows a clear status.
pages.issue: Setup completion does not publish pending content. Identity verification and media approval are separate. Use account support for a stalled or wrong-account state.
extras: Overview: working status. Profile: details/media. Results: your activity. Account: preferences/help.
Keep ID documents inside the secure verification flow; do not send copies to ordinary club email or chat.

pages.title: Main photo and photo uploads
pages.path: Profile > Main photo / Add photos/videos > Photos
steps: Choose your main photo
Use the Main photo controls to upload or Choose uploaded photo. Crop photo adjusts the card; check that your face stays visible.
Check the automatic avatar
It comes from the main image. Adjust the avatar crop if needed; there is no separate club roster photo to maintain.
Add gallery photos
Select Gallery for one or more files or Camera to take a photo. JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC and HEIF are accepted, up to 25 MB each.
Wait for transfer and review
A failed transfer can be retried. Processing and pending approval are different states. The club queue receives new-dancer media after the first NFC connection.
Organize approved photos
Use (...) for available crop, main-photo, pin or remove actions. Pinning changes your profile gallery order, not shared feed placement. Read rejection notes and replace corrected files.
pages.done: The main image and avatar match, and you know each upload status.
pages.issue: The main photo is used for public cards and internal rosters where you are eligible. A saved change is not necessarily approved; the previous approved image may remain during review.
extras: Read Photo rules. Only you (18+) may appear, including reflections. Cover nipples, areolas, genitals and anus; no sexual acts. No logos, watermarks or contact details. Own or have permission for the image. The club performs the full review.

pages.title: Upload videos
steps: Check Video rules
Use vertical or square MP4, WebM or MOV, 1-30 seconds long and up to 25 MB.
Confirm both permissions
Only you are shown and the video is of you; and you own or may publish all visuals and audio, including music.
Choose or record
Select Choose video or Record video. Use the offered crop/trim controls to meet the format and duration rules.
Wait for processing and human review
Keep track of transfer, processing and approval separately. AI checks assist the reviewer; passing them does not publish the file.
Verify approved playback
Open your profile Videos tab and play the complete video. Eligible approved videos can also enter MyDancrTV.
pages.done: The approved file plays correctly and contains permitted visuals and audio.
pages.issue: Music on your phone is not proof of publishing rights. For rejected files, read the correction and submit a compliant replacement.
extras: Failed transfer: retry. Processing: wait. Pending approval: club review. Rejected: read reason and correct the file.

pages.title: Check in and end your shift
pages.path: Dressing-room NFC sticker > Overview > Working Now
steps: Tap the physical sticker
Unlock your phone, tap, open the link if prompted and sign in to your dancer account. No particular dashboard page must be open first. Confirm the club.
Choose where you appear
Internal only: club roster, with a full-profile link. External only: public discovery. Both: both surfaces, subject to your eligibility and visibility.
Finish the displayed requirements
On the first tap, your club can review pending media. If review is pending, wait, then refresh your onboarding/dashboard status.
Check Working Now
Confirm the active club and end time. A check-in lasts up to six hours, followed by a six-hour cooldown across clubs. Retapping does not extend it.
End when you leave
Overview > End Working Now > Yes, end now. Choose Keep working if opened by mistake. Ending early does not bypass the cooldown.
pages.done: Working now reflects the correct club and your actual presence.
pages.issue: Public profile visibility is separate from check-in. An original-account warning needs account recovery/support, not another account.

pages.title: Visibility and profile sharing
steps: Check Profile visibility
Read Public or Incognito before changing anything.
Hide temporarily
Go incognito hides your profile and content without deleting the uploads. Wait for the saved status.
Show it again
Make profile public restores visibility subject to approval and account eligibility.
Share your profile
Expand Share profile > Copy link, or Open profile to inspect the destination.
Check the destination
Confirm your stage name, main photo and approved media before sharing. A copied link does not bypass incognito or approval restrictions.
pages.done: The saved visibility matches your intention and the copied URL is yours.
pages.issue: Internal only is a check-in channel. Incognito is a profile-visibility control. They are not interchangeable.

pages.title: Your results and account help
steps: Choose the period and club
Use This shift, 7 days, 30 days or All time and the club selector. Confirm the filters before comparing.
Read demand and outcomes
Review table requests, VIP requests, returning VIP requesters and verified entries. Request details separates available sources/outcomes.
Read your activity
Review shifts/hours, followers, profile views, likes, video views, trends and top content. Active sessions may not yet appear in completed-session totals.
Keep alerts reachable

Account > Notification preferences: email starts on by default; prior optional-alert choices still apply. Check your mailbox and spam. Enable notifications for phone push; follow the displayed iPhone Add to Home Screen instructions when required.
Get the right help

File transfer: retry or correct. Pending/rejected media: club reviewer. Wrong account or identity step: account support. Missing club activity: duty manager, then support. Include club, dates, time and exact message; never passwords or ID files.
pages.done: You know the period, source and meaning of the figures you are reading.
pages.issue: Requests and I'm Going are interest signals. They do not establish attendance, a booking or earnings.
extras: Check saved profile details and upload statuses, find the club sticker, identify the Working Now end control, and find visibility/preferences. Use read-only navigation or approved training records; check in only when actually working.

pages.title: Start here: open the review queue
steps: Sign in and open club reviews

Use your own owner/manager account at www.mydancr.com > Sign in. Confirm the club, then open Dancers & tables > Media approvals. Staff cannot approve media. Reviewer assignment does not create a separate restricted role; ask the owner for missing access.
Refresh the queue
Select Refresh. New dancers join the club queue after their NFC tap. Check the count and use Previous / Next to work all pages (12 items per page).
Identify the exact item
Read stage name and the Photo, Main photo, Avatar or Video label. Check the actual preview/version, not a previous upload.
Read AI findings
Check running, passed, flagged or manual-review status. Expand AI findings when present. Passing AI is not human approval or proof of identity/rights.
Review, then decide
Use the full checklist on guide p. 2 and the decision guide on p. 3. Never approve a missing preview or unfinished processing.
pages.done: You can inspect the correct item and understand any automated findings.
pages.issue: Disabled approval is not a control to work around. Leave an uninspectable item private and contact the club lead/platform team with the asset reference and error.
extras: This capture shows an empty queue. Pending items add the asset preview, AI findings, Review note, Approve and Reject; Previous / Next appear for multiple pages. Those controls are described here, not shown in this capture.
Wait for the success message and removal from the pending queue. Returning to the first page is normal. An uncertain save requires Refresh before another action.

pages.title: Photo and video review checklist
pages.path: Use on every photo, main image, avatar and video
steps: Inspect the complete asset
Photo: whole frame plus final crop. Avatar: face visible. Video: play every scene with audio from beginning to end; do not approve from its thumbnail.
Check people and coverage
Only the uploader, age 18+, may appear, including in backgrounds/reflections. Apply the coverage rules below.
Check text, objects and audio
Look for brands, logos, watermarks, contact details, solicitation and other prohibited content. Listen to the complete audio.
Check rights and technical readiness
The uploader must own or have permission for all visuals/audio. Review AI findings. Do not override a technical block or guess about identity or rights.
pages.done: Every checklist category has been inspected before a publishing decision.
pages.issue: Any uncertainty about people, age, consent, ownership or inspectability: keep the file private and escalate. AI findings are evidence to review, not a substitute for the checklist.

pages.title: Approve, reject or escalate
steps: Choose the correct outcome
Use the three-way guide below. Escalate means leave the item private and contact the responsible team; it is not a dedicated queue button.
Save once and verify
After Approve or Reject, wait for confirmation and removal from the pending queue. If the upload changed or the result is uncertain, Refresh and inspect the current version.
Review replacements anew
A corrected file is a new review. Inspect the replacement itself; do not approve solely because the previous note was addressed.
Check the release
After approval, inspect the eligible profile/internal/public surface. If still hidden, check remaining enrollment, verification, visibility and channel requirements.
pages.done: The saved outcome matches the exact file inspected, and unresolved content stays private.
pages.issue: One approval can release an asset across eligible internal, external and TV surfaces. It does not override profile eligibility.

pages.title: Review every publishing surface
pages.path: Release checklist beyond the media queue
steps: Dancer media
New photos/videos require human approval, including main images and avatars. Existing approved assets are not automatically re-queued; audit them when a historical review is required.
Profile text
Obtain the reviewer's approval of the proposed stage name, city and other visible copy before saving it. These edits do not all wait in a human queue; check the saved result afterward.
Social links
Send link-review questions to MyDancr Support. Include the dancer and link reference; club media approval does not approve a social link.
Venue pages and branding

Have the responsible reviewer approve the proposed logo, imagery and wording before the venue team saves or publishes them. Review the package and Club Deal before Approve & make live (Operations Manual, p. 5). Branding uses separate processing rules.
Live internal, external and TV views
After a release, check the correct person and approved content. Report unsafe live content to MyDancr Support for the applicable removal/restriction action.
pages.done: Each content type has a review owner, approval of the proposed version and a verified release path.
pages.issue: For text/branding without a technical hold, get approval of the proposed version before saving. Report unsafe live content immediately to MyDancr Support with its reference.
extras: Club policy: the assigned reviewer signs off on content first. For edits without a technical hold, agree the exact file/copy before saving. Do not use the live page as the draft.
Record club, dancer/asset reference, decision, reason when needed, reviewer and time under your team procedure. Avoid duplicating sensitive source media in ordinary messages.
